title: Intermittent document export delays
frame: A hosted document service exports customer workspaces overnight. Median export time is stable, but roughly one in twenty exports now takes more than an hour instead of ten minutes. Export traces include queue entry, worker start, object reads and archive upload; trace coverage differs across worker versions. Customers cannot be asked to rerun large exports during business hours. The engineering team must plan a safe investigation and choose the next deployment action.
